WITH media_type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    m.Name as MediaTypeName,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / t.Milliseconds) as AvgBytesPerMs
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT 
  mta.MediaTypeName,
  mta.AvgBytesPerMs,
  mta.AvgBytesPerMs - (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) FROM media_type_averages) as DiffFromOverallAvg
FROM media_type_averages mta
WHERE mta.AvgBytesPerMs > (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) FROM media_type_averages)
ORDER BY mta.MediaTypeName
